title: Quiz: Database Capstone
description: Check your understanding of Database Capstone.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in SQL?
questions.explanation: In SQL, -- marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What proves a capstone schema is done?
questions.correctAnswer: It answers real questions correctly with clean, documented queries

questions.question: True or False: A schema you cannot query well is not finished.
What is the main purpose of the Database Capstone technique shown in this lesson?
questions.explanation: It exists to help you database capstone effectively.

questions.question: In SQL, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
